# Synaptic Modifications in Cultured Hippocampal Neurons (Bi & Poo, 1998)

This foundational experimental paper demonstrated that the precise relative timing between pre- and post-synaptic action potentials determines long-term potentiation (LTP) or long-term depression (LTD).

## Critical Finding

- Pre-before-post spike intervals within 20 ms induced robust LTP.
- Post-before-pre spike intervals within 20 ms led to significant LTD.
